f4390c91e06a927f.column_purpose: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each city row (1..4079).

f1905d8ca96a328a.column_purpose: City name (e.g. 'Lubao', 'Matsumoto'). Not unique; some names repeat across countries.

64687c71a92c2c64.column_purpose: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (CHN, IND, USA, ...), referencing the country table.

7dd75887d5fac6b4.column_purpose: First-level administrative subdivision of the country the city is in (state/province/region), e.g. 'Central Luzon', 'Nagano', 'California'.

3be19254fd64ed67.column_purpose: City population in persons; ranges from 42 to 10,500,000.

ce17d4fc538ffc89.column_purpose: Primary key: 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. ABW=Aruba, GBR=United Kingdom, LAO=Laos). Referenced by city.col_003 and countrylanguage.col_001.

68204c0d5121729f.column_purpose: English name of the country (e.g. 'Afghanistan', 'Sierra Leone'). Unique per row.

0139b6fc28e80d7f.column_purpose: Continent the country belongs to; 7 values: Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, Antarctica.

f2410a5415d79c6a.column_purpose: Sub-continental region within the continent (e.g. 'Caribbean', 'Eastern Africa', 'Southeast Asia', 'Western Africa').

0884913b2a20ffe8.column_purpose: Land area of the country in square kilometers (range 0.4 to 17,075,400; e.g. Laos 236,800, Sierra Leone 71,740).

60a3901870e121e1.column_purpose: Year the country gained independence (e.g. 1960, 1991, 1776 for USA). Null for territories that are not independent (e.g. British Indian Ocean Territory). The negative minimum (-1523) is odd and may be a data artifact (e.g. an ancient date encoded oddly); the join to city.col_001 is spurious.

5b526a2899832727.column_purpose: Country population in persons (range 0 to ~1.28 billion; e.g. Laos 5,433,000, Sierra Leone 4,854,000).

e9347df82eecd9a6.column_purpose: Average life expectancy in years (range 37.2–83.5, mean ~66.5; e.g. Laos 53.1, Sierra Leone 45.3). Null for uninhabited/unknown territories.

d458a2f5a39ac502.column_purpose: Gross National Product, in millions of US dollars (e.g. Laos 1292, Sierra Leone 746; 0 for territories without an economy).

3a0dc9730a14b8e2.column_purpose: Older/previous GNP figure, in millions of US dollars, same magnitude as col_009 (e.g. Laos 1746 vs current 1292). Null for ~25% of rows. Exact vintage (previous year vs older source) is not determinable from the data; no joins provide further evidence.

6d2d5c356bad11c4.column_purpose: Country name in local language(s) or non-English form (e.g. 'Afganistan/Afqanestan', 'Al-Jaza'ir/Algérie', 'Lao').

2ca6e72517f8aa26.column_purpose: Form of government (e.g. 'Republic', 'Constitutional Monarchy', 'Dependent Territory of the UK', 'Monarchy (Sultanate)').

de8e14378f26998b.column_purpose: Name of the head of state (e.g. 'Elisabeth II' for Commonwealth realms, 'Jacques Chirac', 'Khamtay Siphandone'). Data reflects ~2000-2005 era.

1504ae0dfe4c6d03.column_purpose: Foreign key to city.col_001 identifying the country's capital city (one-to-one join accepted by statistics; null for territories without a capital).

7d5b878c36cb0176.column_purpose: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'LA' for Laos, 'SL' for Sierra Leone, 'IO' for British Indian Ocean Territory).

60412074b817dd28.column_purpose: ISO 3-letter country code (e.g. IND, USA, CAN), referencing country.col_001; many languages per country.

c04394febf3f740a.column_purpose: Name of the language spoken in the country (e.g. Urdu, English, Creole English).

5733835373cdbd53.column_purpose: Whether the language is official in the country: 'T' = true (official), 'F' = false (not official).

b3b17af5a559878a.column_purpose: Percentage (0-100) of the country's population that speaks the language; 100.0 means the whole population.
